meta_data.base_class: Retrieve specific information about a signed <regional treaty> - <regional treaty> refers to a formal agreement signed between countries or political entities within a specific geographic region, typically regulating diplomatic, economic, military, or legal matters relevant to that region.

tool_template.name: regional_treaty_info
tool_template.description: Retrieve specific information about a signed <class>.

info_requested.description: Specific aspects of the <class> for which to return information.

time_period.description: A time range or approximate period when the <class> was signed, typically expressed in years (e.g., '1945-1960').

treaty_type.description: The category or focus of the <class>, such as 'economic', 'military', 'diplomatic', or 'environmental'.

status.description: The current legal or operational status of the <class>, such as 'active', 'terminated', or 'pending ratification'.

country_involved.description: A specific country that is a signatory to the <class>, used to filter treaties involving that nation.
